title: Payment API Connection Pool Exhaustion
symptoms: High latency (8.4s) and 21% error rate on POST /v1/charges with pool timeout exceptions
root_cause: Database connection pool saturated during traffic burst
recent_changes: Traffic surge from flash sale campaign
action_taken: Increased connection pool size from 50 to 200 and restarted pods
side_effects: None. Latency returned to 120ms within 4 minutes.

title: Payment API Memory Spike Post-Pool Increase
symptoms: OOMKilled pods and 35% error rate following pool expansion
root_cause: PostgreSQL 15 PgBouncer migration introduced connection multiplexing incompatibilities under high raw pool limits
recent_changes: PgBouncer pooled proxy migration and schema update 30m ago
action_taken: Increased pool limit to 250
side_effects: Cascading OOM crashes across all payment replica pods. 15 minute total outage.

title: Payment API Schema Lock Contention
symptoms: Latency spike to 9.2s and 25% 504 Gateway Timeouts
root_cause: Exclusive table lock held by unindexed concurrent column migration
recent_changes: Database migration executed 34 minutes ago without CONCURRENTLY flag
action_taken: Rolled back deployment to v5.3.9 and cancelled pending migration transaction
side_effects: Zero data corruption; read queries restored in 90 seconds.

title: Auth Service Redis Read Replica Desync
symptoms: Token verification failure rate 18%, elevated login latency 3.2s
root_cause: Redis replica replication lag exceeding client timeout
recent_changes: Network policy update in auth namespace
action_taken: Forced auth clients to bypass replicas and read exclusively from Redis Primary
side_effects: Primary CPU rose by 12%, well within headroom.

title: Auth Service Primary Overload after Replica Bypass
symptoms: Redis Primary 100% CPU, total authentication failure 500s
root_cause: Bypassing read replicas overwhelmed single primary under peak 80k rps load
recent_changes: Scale event: 4x traffic increase for Black Friday
action_taken: Routed all reads to Primary node
side_effects: Primary crashed, causing cascading outage across SSO and all downstream microservices.

title: User Profile Service Slow Queries
symptoms: p99 response time degraded from 40ms to 4.1s
root_cause: Missing composite index on user_preferences_v2 table
recent_changes: Feature flag enabled for dynamic avatar preferences
action_taken: Applied CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_user_prefs on MySQL replica and promoted
side_effects: Minor I/O spike for 45s during index build.

title: Profile Service Index Build Deadlock on Aurora
symptoms: Database write stalls and application thread starvation
root_cause: Direct schema alteration conflicted with active row-level locks on Aurora Serverless v2
recent_changes: Dynamic preference release
action_taken: Applied direct DDL migration online
side_effects: Metadata lock blocked all writes for 18 minutes.

title: Order Ingestion Kafka Consumer Lag
symptoms: Consumer lag exceeded 450,000 messages, checkout confirmation delayed 5m
root_cause: Slow third-party tax calculation API holding consumer threads
recent_changes: Tax service endpoint switched to new vendor API
action_taken: Scaled consumer pod replicas from 8 to 24 and increased consumer timeout
side_effects: Lag dropped to 0 in 7 minutes.

title: Order Processing Partition Rebalance Storm
symptoms: Complete consumption halt, continuous rebalance loop across consumer group
root_cause: Aggressive scaling beyond topic partition count (32 pods for 16 partitions) triggered perpetual rebalancing
recent_changes: Topic partition count reconfigured down to 16
action_taken: Scaled consumer pods from 8 to 32
side_effects: Topic blocked; duplicate order processing occurred.

title: Inventory Service Thread Pool Starvation
symptoms: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable on stock reserve API
root_cause: Blocking gRPC calls to warehouse legacy gateway exhausted Tomcat worker threads
recent_changes: Warehouse sync job batch size enlarged
action_taken: Enabled circuit breaker fallback with cached stock estimates and restarted pods
side_effects: 0.01% inventory reconciliation discrepancy resolved overnight.

title: Inventory Service Circuit Breaker False Negative
symptoms: Overselling out-of-stock items resulting in 400+ customer cancellations
root_cause: Fallback cached stock estimates served stale data during flash warehouse inventory zeroing
recent_changes: Flash inventory reduction campaign
action_taken: Flipped circuit breaker to default fallback cache
side_effects: Significant financial refund liability and customer complaints.

title: API Gateway Nginx Worker Starvation
symptoms: Connection reset by peer on 14% of ingress traffic
root_cause: File descriptor limit (nofile 1024) hit during mobile client retry storm
recent_changes: Mobile app push notification sent to 2M users
action_taken: Updated sysctl fs.file-max and ulimit worker_rlimit_nofile to 65535
side_effects: Clean ingress resolution within 3 minutes.

title: Notification Service RabbitMQ Queue Backpressure
symptoms: SMS and Email delivery delays reaching 40 minutes
root_cause: Unacknowledged messages filled Erlang memory watermark, pausing publishers
recent_changes: Marketing promo campaign broadcast
action_taken: Purged dead-letter exchange, bumped consumer prefetch count to 50, and doubled worker instances
side_effects: Backlog cleared in 11 minutes without message loss.

title: Notification Service Quorum Queue Purge Failure
symptoms: Queue unresponsiveness and message loss for critical 2FA OTP codes
root_cause: RabbitMQ 3.12 Quorum Queues do not support legacy purge mechanics without Raft leader quorum
recent_changes: Migrated from classic mirrored queues to Quorum queues
action_taken: Executed legacy queue purge script
side_effects: Dropped 12,000 OTP tokens, blocking all user logins.

title: Search Service Elasticsearch Heap Saturation
symptoms: Search query response time spiking from 80ms to 6.5s, cluster state Yellow
root_cause: Heavy wild-card aggregations in new catalog search UI causing Old Gen GC pauses
recent_changes: Deploy v5.1.0 with complex regex query filters
action_taken: Disabled fielddata on high-cardinality text fields and enabled circuit breaker indices.breaker.fielddata.limit: 40%
side_effects: Heap usage dropped from 94% to 58% immediately.

title: Search Service OpenSearch Shard Allocation Failure
symptoms: Cluster state RED, 40% of search queries failing with 500
root_cause: OpenSearch cluster migration changed shard allocation settings, rejecting legacy elasticsearch.yml parameters
recent_changes: Elasticsearch to AWS OpenSearch managed service migration
action_taken: Injected legacy fielddata circuit breaker via raw cluster settings API
side_effects: Rejected config crashed master node orchestrator.

title: Billing Webhook Ingestion Rate Limit Exceeded
symptoms: Payment gateway webhooks failing with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
root_cause: Rate limiter bucket threshold configured too strictly for batch subscription renewals
recent_changes: 1st of month recurring subscription billing batch trigger
action_taken: Dynamically updated rate limit token bucket refill rate from 50/s to 500/s in config map
side_effects: All 45,000 queued webhooks ingested in 6 minutes.

title: Billing Service DB Lockout after Rate Limit Surge
symptoms: PostgreSQL Max Connections reached (500/500), cascading 500 errors
root_cause: Increasing rate limit refill rate overwhelmed downstream DB without connection pooling
recent_changes: Batch billing trigger
action_taken: Increased rate limiter refill rate to 1000/s
side_effects: Database exhausted max connections and had to be forcibly restarted.

title: Recommendation Engine Model Inference Latency
symptoms: p95 latency spike to 4.8s on personalized homepage feed
root_cause: ONNX model inference running on single-threaded CPU runtime
recent_changes: New transformer ranking model deployed
action_taken: Enabled TensorRT execution provider with fp16 precision on GPU node pool
side_effects: Latency dropped to 22ms; GPU memory utilization stable at 65%.

title: Recommendation Engine GPU Driver Incompatibility
symptoms: CrashLoopBackOff on all recommendation inference worker pods
root_cause: CUDA 12.2 container image incompatible with older host NVIDIA driver 515.65
recent_changes: Node group upgraded to K8s 1.28 with legacy GPU daemonset
action_taken: Forced TensorRT CUDA 12.2 startup flags
side_effects: Pods failed to initialize CUDA context, knocking out recommendations completely.

title: Cart Service Stale Session Data
symptoms: Users seeing empty carts after adding items or switching tabs
root_cause: Sticky session cookie format changed in gateway without backward compatibility
recent_changes: Gateway routing update 15m ago
action_taken: Rolled back gateway routing rule to restore original session cookie parser
side_effects: Session persistence restored immediately.

title: Cart Service DynamoDB Throttling under Uncached Query
symptoms: ProvisionedThroughputExceededException on CartSessions table
root_cause: Missing DAX cache layer on read-heavy cart checkout validation loop
recent_changes: Switch from provisioned capacity to On-Demand with sudden 10x traffic spike
action_taken: Enabled DAX in-memory acceleration cluster and pre-warmed partitions
side_effects: Initial 2 minutes experienced cold cache read spikes before stabilizing.

title: Checkout Service Third-Party Fraud API Outage
symptoms: Checkout page hanging for 30s before throwing 500 error
root_cause: Sift Fraud API experiencing global DNS outage
recent_changes: No internal change; external vendor degraded
action_taken: Switched fraud evaluation to soft-fail async mode via runtime feature flag
side_effects: Risk exposure temporarily managed with post-settlement audit flags.

title: Checkout Service Soft-Fail Fraud Vulnerability
symptoms: Bot attack bypassed soft-fail fraud checks, causing $18k in fraudulent card testing
root_cause: Soft-fail feature flag remained active during high-velocity scripted attack
recent_changes: Botnet IP rotation targeted checkout endpoint
action_taken: Enabled soft-fail mode across all IP ranges
side_effects: Severe chargeback risk; required emergency Cloudflare WAF rule creation.

title: Email Dispatcher TLS Certificate Expiration
symptoms: Outbound SMTP TLS handshake failure on port 587
root_cause: SendGrid client TLS certificate expired without automated cert-manager renewal
recent_changes: Cert-manager ingress controller update
action_taken: Renewed and reloaded TLS secret via kubectl and triggered cert-manager re-issue
side_effects: Zero email loss; queue flushed in 3 minutes.

title: Media Processing CPU Throttling on Kubernetes
symptoms: Video transcoding job duration increased from 45s to 12 minutes
root_cause: CFS CPU quota throttling due to tight cpu-limit definitions on multi-threaded FFmpeg
recent_changes: Resource quota limits enforced on media namespace
action_taken: Removed CPU limits while preserving CPU requests and enabled node auto-scaling
side_effects: Transcode duration restored to 38s.

title: Media Transcoder Node OOM Crash without CPU Limits
symptoms: Node kernel panics and eviction of adjacent critical pods
root_cause: Uncapped FFmpeg instances consumed all system memory on shared node pool
recent_changes: High resolution 4K video upload feature launched
action_taken: Removed all resource limits
side_effects: 4 cluster worker nodes crashed simultaneously.

title: Analytics Pipeline ClickHouse Disk Watermark Hit
symptoms: ClickHouse table read-only mode activated; event ingestion halted
root_cause: Disk utilization reached 92% (watermark threshold) on raw trace partitions
recent_changes: Debug trace level enabled across all production services
action_taken: Dropped older partition tables older than 30 days and expanded EBS volume online
side_effects: Disk usage dropped to 64%; ingest resumed in 2 minutes.

title: Telemetry Pipeline Dropping Partitions Data Loss
symptoms: Compliance audit failure due to irreversible loss of regulatory audit logs
root_cause: Automated partition dropping script purged security log tables along with debug traces
recent_changes: Security compliance retention rule enacted
action_taken: Ran emergency drop partition script
side_effects: Permanent loss of 14 days of audit trail logs.

title: Identity Provider SAML Certificate Rotation Crash
symptoms: Enterprise customers unable to login via Okta/Azure AD SSO
root_cause: SAML response signature verification failed after cert rollover due to cached public key
recent_changes: Annual IdP certificate rollover scheduled
action_taken: Evicted IdP metadata cache in Redis and restarted SSO gateway pods
side_effects: SSO authentications recovered across all 150 enterprise tenants.

title: Inventory Sync Webhook Deadlock with ERP
symptoms: ERP webhook latency 14s, database transaction lock timeouts
root_cause: Unordered batch item updates causing cyclic foreign key locks against warehouse ERP
recent_changes: ERP API updated to batch version 2.0
action_taken: Sorted incoming SKU IDs prior to acquisition of row-level lock in transaction block
side_effects: Transaction contention eliminated completely.

title: WebSocket Gateway Connection Storm
symptoms: 50,000 WebSocket connections dropped simultaneously during pod rollover
root_cause: Thundering herd reconnect on client web sockets without exponential backoff jitter
recent_changes: Rolling deployment of new gateway version
action_taken: Enabled client connection rate limiter at HAProxy layer and staggered rolling updates
side_effects: Reconnect completed over 4 minutes with minor message delay.

title: GraphQL Gateway Field Suggestion CPU Denial of Service
symptoms: Node.js event loop lag > 2000ms, CPU pegged at 100%
root_cause: Deeply nested recursive introspection queries generated by security scanner
recent_changes: Automated security penetration test initiated
action_taken: Configured query complexity max depth limit to 6 and disabled public introspection in production
side_effects: Event loop returned to 2ms.

title: GraphQL Introspection Disable Breaking Mobile App
symptoms: Legacy mobile apps (v2.1) crashing on startup for 35,000 active users
root_cause: Legacy mobile app relied on dynamic runtime introspection query during initial boot
recent_changes: Mobile app deprecation schedule delayed
action_taken: Disabled introspection globally without client version filtering
side_effects: Major consumer app outage lasting 45 minutes.

title: Shipping Label Service Third-Party Rate Limit
symptoms: FedEx label creation failing with 429 Too Many Requests
root_cause: FedEx API rate limit hit due to retry storm from brief 503 response
recent_changes: Holiday shipping surge
action_taken: Switched carrier fallback route to UPS API for standard parcel shipments
side_effects: Shipping cost increased by 3% for 2 hours, but zero customer shipment delays.

title: Shipping Carrier Fallback Address Format Incompatibility
symptoms: 3,200 international labels failed with 'Invalid Postal Code' error
root_cause: UPS API required strict 9-digit postal format for EU addresses unlike FedEx lenient parser
recent_changes: International expansion to 8 European countries
action_taken: Triggered generic carrier fallback without address schema validation
side_effects: 3,200 orders stranded in fulfillment warehouse.

title: Customer Support Live Chat Memory Leak
symptoms: Pod memory consumption monotonically rising by 200MB/hr until OOM kill
root_cause: Unsubscribed event listeners on disconnected Socket.io client sessions
recent_changes: New agent typing indicator feature deployed
action_taken: Patched event listener cleanup in disconnect handler and hot-reloaded pods
side_effects: Memory leak flattened to zero.

title: Customer Support Chat Hot-Reload Socket Disconnects
symptoms: All 1,800 active VIP support conversations abruptly severed
root_cause: Hot-reload triggered SIGTERM without graceful session drain on Socket.io cluster
recent_changes: Node.js 20 runtime upgrade with strict signal handling
action_taken: Triggered immediate rolling pod restart
side_effects: Agents had to manually re-initiate lost customer sessions.

title: Audit Log Kafka Producer Memory Buffer Overflow
symptoms: Audit service blocking critical checkout transactions due to synchronous audit write
root_cause: Kafka broker network partition caused producer buffer.memory to fill, triggering block-on-full
recent_changes: Strict compliance mode enabled: max.block.ms set to 60000ms
action_taken: Changed audit log producer to non-blocking local disk spooling with background replay worker
side_effects: Zero checkout disruption and 100% audit durability preserved.

title: Audit Log Spooling Disk Saturation on Micro Pods
symptoms: Container ephemeral storage exceeded 10GB limit; Kubernetes evicted all audit pods
root_cause: Local disk spooling on stateless container without persistent volume during 6-hour Kafka outage
recent_changes: Stateless pod refactor on ephemeral nodes
action_taken: Switched to local ephemeral disk spooling
side_effects: Pod eviction loop and compliance alerting escalation to CISO.
